note: Packaged MCP server entries for the Antigravity native lane (Plan 032 Phase 8, ADR 0032). One entry per server name the registry agents declare in `mcpServers:`; the launch command is the one the existing server definitions use (src/core/prerequisites.ts getMcpDefinition, pinned by test). Each `entry` is merged as-is into .agents/mcp_config.json under its name. No entry carries `env`, `headers` or `oauth`: a credential is never written. A server that needs one (`requiresEnv` is not empty) is not written at all: a `disabled: true` entry still started once in a real session (ADR 0032 addendum 2), so the install prints its `entry` and the variable instead, for the user to add once they hold the credential and have set it in the environment agy starts from (agy passes its own environment to a stdio server, observed 2026-10-03). No `${VAR}` placeholder is written: agy did not expand one (observed).
